title: Genshin Impact Anomaly: How to Find All Unexplained Phenomena and Complete Epilogue Quests in 7.1
excerpt: How to complete the story epilogue in patch 7.1: where to find all the anomalies and how to unlock the required locations in Genshin Impact.
content:
Strange markings appeared in the sky above Teyvat.

В Genshin Impact Mysterious anomalies appear in different regions of Teyvat after completing the Archons quest. Requiem for the AfterlifeAfter defeating the Shadow of Death, a strange glow appeared where the Thorns of Punishment fell. Head there and find out what's going on.

Content

Walkthrough of the final quest "Anomaly" in Genshin Impact

The hidden epilogue will automatically begin immediately after the final dialogue in the mission. "Black feathers that fell at the hour of farewell"Go to your quest log or the events menu and select which task you want to take on. You can complete them in any order, but keep in mind that this event is temporary, and some locations are unlocked through quests.

Anomaly: Snow

The area from where the mysterious glow is visible is located to the east of SnezhnogradYou can get there from the nearest teleporter: follow the railroad until you reach the place. A worried man will be waiting there. Hunter Alyosha, looking in the direction of the remains Cryo Dragon — a possible new location for update 7.2.

Anomaly: Mondstadt

Get to the top dragon spine it's only possible through a chain of missions "In the mountains"Before climbing up, put an Anemo hero on your team to activate the pedestal and a Pyro companion in case you freeze.

To get to the Skyfrost Thorn, follow these steps:

  • Go to the teleport next to the dungeon "Peak of Vindagnyr", then turn right and start moving up the spiral.
  • Go through the columns next to the warming monument and approach the rock on the left.
  • Climb the rock using any convenient method.
  • Activate the Anemo Pedestal and fly up on the stream, then move through the acceleration rings.
  • Defeat the Hilichurls sitting by the fire, then move along the right side.
  • Next, you need to climb the ruined tower. You can take the spiral route or climb straight up using hero skills or climbing.

Anomaly: Li Yue

In the kingdom of contracts the thorn is in the area RiftThere are no additional quests to complete. Head to the Archon Statue of the Great Mine and discuss the situation with Adept Xiao.

Anomaly: Inazuma

Celestia's Thorn once fell on the territory Tsurumi Islands. The situation is under control. High Priestess Yae Miko, but getting into the area isn't so easy. You'll have to complete the following quests:

  • "Ritou Escape Plan" и "Letter to Chisato" - for free movement around Inazuma.
  • "The Seirai Stormchasers" - a mandatory requirement for Tsurumi missions.
  • "Through the Fog" — the key chain of the region, stretched over three real days.

Anomaly: Sumeru

The mysterious glow is located in the desert on Mount Damavand, right above the storm behind which the Oasis of Eternity is hidden. Travel to the Archon statue and speak with the desert dwellers. Candace и Dehya.

This zone includes a series of tasks "Panikhida Bilcis", which opens the way to the tomb of the Goddess of Flowers, but it is not known for sure whether it is necessary to go through it for this meeting.

Anomaly: Natlan

In the war zone, a pillar of light is located directly above the Holy Flame Stadium. You can get there on foot or by teleporting to the nearest teleportation point. There's already a Piro Archon Mavuika.
